climate: A dry climate, with little rain while the vines grow. Water is scarce and the dry air keeps disease down.

blurb.text: A Canary Islands appellation covering the whole of El Hierro, the smallest and westernmost of the islands. It gained its DO in 1995, and its rules allow still, sparkling, liqueur and overripe-grape wines from local grapes such as Listán Blanco and Negramoll.
